notes: Portable Annex C.3 object-attribute composition uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador interfaces with adapter-owned FOM modules. It checks the positive disjoint attribute-set union through both handle lookups, rejects conflicting semantics for one same-named attribute as InconsistentFOM, and checks a valid federation-name retry. Native official-API and installed-package results are recorded in the roadmap handoff; Java provider runtime and interoperability are not verified. No other attribute sub-elements are claimed.
